description:
Read dated RS3 price history for one known GE item. Resolve names with lookup_item; use get_item_details for current records or candidate comparisons.

- itemId=4151 means Abyssal whip, not a quantity. For observations, choose Jagex for provider averages over roughly 180 days or Weirdgloop for daily samples with reported volume over roughly 90 days.
- from/to include whole UTC days. Equal bounds cover that day; omitted bounds retain all available history. Requested dates cannot extend retention.
- statistics computes min/max, unweighted mean and start-to-end change from a fixed 90-day Weirdgloop fetch. For example, days=7 takes the last seven usable samples even if missing dates make them span more than a week.
- Each call returns its full retained series or statistics in one bounded response; there is no cursor or next page. Unavailable observation dates return empty data; unusable statistics history returns an error. Invalid bounds fail before fetching.
- Reads are uncached and require no credentials. Provider errors surface without switching sources or retrying automatically. HTTP defaults to 60 requests/IP/minute; wait for Retry-After after 429.

days.description: Sample window for the statistics view

from.description: First UTC date to include; omitted means start of available history

itemId.description: Known GE item ID resolved with lookup_item

source.description: History data provider; allowed values and defaults depend on view

to.description: Last UTC date to include; omitted means end of available history

view.description: Raw observations (original default) or computed Weirdgloop statistics

name: get_price_series

average.description: Jagex averaged guide prices in coins, keyed by Unix timestamp in milliseconds

daily.description: Daily guide prices in coins, keyed by Unix timestamp in milliseconds

samples.description: Chronological usable observations; malformed timestamp/price rows are discarded, unreported volume omitted, and an entirely malformed nonempty feed is an error

timestamp.description: UTC Unix timestamp in milliseconds, not seconds

source.description: Present for the Weirdgloop sample-array variant

avgDailyVolume.description: Unweighted mean of reported daily volumes, rounded to a whole number; unreported values are excluded

avgPrice.description: Average price in the window, rounded to whole coins

changePct.description: Percent change across the window, rounded to two decimals; 0 when the oldest price is 0

latestPrice.description: Newest price in the window, in coins

maxPrice.description: Highest price in the window, in coins

minPrice.description: Lowest price in the window, in coins

name.description: Name supplied by the caller, when given

oldestPriceInWindow.description: Oldest price in the window, in coins

title: Read Item Price History
